title: Harmony 'ONE for BSC/Ethereum' NativeOFT escrows + four Gnosis Safe L2 treasury multisigs
closed_reasons: H-39 OFT withdraw() is self-only and every external address has 0 internal balance (100% of internal supply is escrowed at the contract address itself)

H-39 lzReceive() reverts 'LzApp: invalid endpoint caller' for anyone but the LZ endpoint, and even the genuine endpoint is rejected because trustedRemoteLookup(101/102) was cleared to 0x on 2026-08-30

H-39 sendFrom(_from=contract) reverts 'ERC20: insufficient allowance' (the escrow cannot be debited by outsiders); outbound is additionally blocked by LayerZero BLOCK_VERSION (65535) send/receive versions
H-39 owner functions are Ownable-gated to a single EOA (0xAC0248e9C78774bA0ef9E71B1Ce1393a10C17E3C)

H-40 Safes are canonical Gnosis Safe L2 v1.3.0 (proxy+singleton+fallback handler code hashes match Ethereum) with no modules and no guard; execTransaction reverts GS020/GS021/GS026 without threshold owner signatures
key_facts: H-39a 0x5B18a4E73F9A4fe337A072516b317863Ad3046aA 'ONE for BSC' (LZ v1 NativeOFT, code keccak 0x4310a9b2...): 62,531,259.468551870330371539 ONE; totalSupply == native balance == balanceOf(contract) exactly

H-39 freeze: owner cleared trusted remotes and set send/receive versions to BLOCK_VERSION on 2026-08-30 (blocks 93,144,294 / 93,144,382); last inbound bridge event 2026-08-11 (block 92,723,721); hasStoredPayload=false (nothing to replay)
H-40 4th address resolved by enumerating 330 Safe proxy factory (0xc22834581ebc8527d974f8a1c97e1bea4ef910bc) ProxyCreation events

Code identity: Safe proxy keccak 0xb89c1b3bdf2cf8827818646bce9a8f6e372885f8c55e5c07acbd307cb133b000; SafeL2 v1.3.0 singleton keccak 0x21842597390c4c6e3c1239e434a682b054bd9548eee5e9b1d6a4482731023c0f; CompatibilityFallbackHandler keccak 0x03e69f7ce809e81687c69b19a7d7cca45b6d551ffdec73d9bb87178476de1abf
H-40 owners: 19 unique EOAs, no overlaps, none is the H-39 OFT owner; only owner-churn (addOwnerWithThreshold/removeOwner) was ever executed
Prices: ONE = $0.00245693 (DefiLlama 2026-10-04); P = $339,218.85 (Safes); S = $185,824.14 (OFT escrows); total in scope $525,042.99

Historical remotes (set 2022-10-17, cleared 2026-08-30): BSC 0x2332137ae0386783ffbcf40d9f17e50890917e15 (ProxyOFT, still wired to the Harmony OFT, holds 211,111 BEP-20 ONE), Ethereum 0x234784ec001db36c9c22785cad902221fd831352; gen-1 sibling OFTs on Harmony hold 0 and 10 ONE
Category split avoids double counting: the OFT escrow is classified S today (owner-only unfreeze path is latent P, not counted again)
caveats: H-39 'stuck' is today's frozen state: the single EOA owner can re-enable versions + trusted remote; wrapped-ONE holders on BSC/Ethereum could then redeem (their claims not quantified here)
Owner-key compromise of 0xAC0248... would enable a full drain of the 75.63M ONE escrow (privileged path, not E-U)
Safe owner-key liveness cannot be read on-chain; lost owner sets would turn P into S
Remote BSC/Ethereum counterpart contracts were not re-audited; the Harmony-side E-U=$0 verdict does not depend on them
Balances are point-in-time at block 93,624,315 and are asserted exactly in the CI fork tests
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Harmony 'ONE for BSC/Ethereum' escrows and the four treasury Safes (high confidence); 75.63M ONE is owner-frozen bridge escrow and 138.07M ONE sits behind canonical 2/3-of-4/5 EOA multisigs.
